quranTranslation.text: If ye help him not, still Allah helped him when those who disbelieve drove him forth, the second of two; when they two were in the cave, when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not. Lo! Allah is with us. Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him and supported him with hosts ye cannot see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the nethermost, while Allah's Word it was that became the uppermost. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

explanation.bs: „…kad je govorio svome drugu (لِصَاحِبِهِ): Ne tuguj“ – drug u pećini, prema tefsiru Ebu Bekr.
explanation.en: “…when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not” — the companion in the cave, Abu Bakr according to tafsir.

quranTranslation.text: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

explanation.bs: „Nije zalutao vaš drug (صَاحِبُكُمْ)“ – Poslanik kao onaj koga dobro poznaju.
explanation.en: “Your comrade erreth not” — the Prophet as one they know well.

quranTranslation.text: O my fellow-prisoners! Are divers lords better, or Allah the One, Almighty?

explanation.bs: „O moja dva druga iz tamnice!“ – drugovi po okolnosti.
explanation.en: “O my fellow-prisoners!” — companions by circumstance.

quranTranslation.text: Who is better in religion than he who surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good (to men) and followeth the tradition of Abraham, the upright? Allah (Himself) chose Abraham for friend.

explanation.bs: „…a Allah je Ibrahima uzeo za prisnog prijatelja (خَلِيلًا)“ – najviši stupanj bliskosti.
explanation.en: “Allah (Himself) chose Abraham for friend” — the highest degree of closeness.

quranTranslation.text: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!

explanation.bs: „Teško meni! Kamo sreće da onoga nisam uzeo za prisnog prijatelja!“ – kajanje zbog lošeg prijatelja.
explanation.en: “Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!” — regret over a bad friend.

quranTranslation.text: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).

explanation.bs: „Prijatelji (الْأَخِلَّاءُ) će toga dana biti neprijatelji jedni drugima, osim bogobojaznih“ – prijateljstvo koje nije na bogobojaznosti ne izdrži.
explanation.en: “Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah)” — friendship not built on taqwa does not endure.

quranTranslation.text: Nor any loving friend.

explanation.bs: „…ni odana prijatelja (صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ)“ – prijatelj koji tog dana nedostaje.
explanation.en: “Nor any loving friend” — the friend missed on that Day.

quranTranslation.text: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

explanation.bs: „…ili kod vašeg prijatelja (صَدِيقِكُمْ)“ – prijatelj s pravom bliskosti u kući.
explanation.en: “…or (from the house) of a friend” — a friend with the right of closeness in one's home.

quranTranslation.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.

explanation.bs: „I sina Merjemina i njegovu majku učinili smo znakom“ – ar-Rāġib: rečeno je ‚znakom‘, a ne ‚dvama znakovima‘, jer je svako od njih znak po onom drugom.
explanation.en: “And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent (آيَةً)” — ar-Rāġib: ‘a sign’, not ‘two signs’, because each became a sign through the other.

quranTranslation.text: But it is clear revelations in the hearts of those who have been given knowledge, and none deny Our revelations save wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „Ne, on je (mnogi mufessiri kažu: Kur'an) niz jasnih ajeta u prsima onih kojima je dano znanje“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But it [the Quran, as many mufassirun explain] is clear revelations in the hearts of those who have been given knowledge” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect.

explanation.bs: „Među Njegovim znakovima je i to što vam je od vaše vlastite vrste stvorio parove, da biste kod njih nalazili smiraj.“
explanation.en: “And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them.”

quranTranslation.text: And they say: None entereth paradise unless he be a Jew or a Christian. These are their own desires. Say: Bring your proof (of what ye state) if ye are truthful.

explanation.bs: „Reci: Donesite svoj dokaz ako govorite istinu!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Say: Bring your proof (of what ye state) if ye are truthful” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Now hath a proof from your Lord come unto you, and We have sent down unto you a clear light;

explanation.bs: „O ljudi, došao vam je dokaz od vašeg Gospodara“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O mankind! Now hath a proof from your Lord come unto you” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Thrust thy hand into the bosom of thy robe it will come forth white without hurt. And guard thy heart from fear. Then these shall be two proofs from your Lord unto Pharaoh and his chiefs. Lo! they are evil-living folk.

explanation.bs: Musau, kad je izvukao ruku bijelu: „To su dva dokaza od tvoga Gospodara faraonu i njegovim glavešinama.“
explanation.en: To Moses, as he drew out his hand white: “Then these shall be two proofs from your Lord unto Pharaoh and his chiefs.”

quranTranslation.text: And to (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. A wonder from your Lord hath come unto you. Lo! this is the camel of Allah, a token unto you; so let her feed in Allah's earth, and touch her not with hurt lest painful torment seize you.

explanation.bs: Salih: „Došlo vam je očigledno svjedočanstvo od vašeg Gospodara: ovo je Allahova deva, vama kao znak“ – svjedočanstvo osjetilima.
explanation.en: Ṣāliḥ: “A wonder (بَيِّنَةٌ) from your Lord hath come unto you. Lo! this is the camel of Allah, a token unto you” — evidence to the senses.

quranTranslation.text: When ye were on the near bank (of the valley) and they were on the yonder bank, and the caravan was below you (on the coast plain). And had ye trysted to meet one another ye surely would have failed to keep the tryst, but (it happened, as it did, without the forethought of either of you) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done; that he who perished (on that day) might perish by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty) and he who survived might survive by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty). Lo! Allah in truth is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „… da propadne onaj ko propadne nakon očiglednog svjedočanstva, i da živi onaj ko živi nakon očiglednog svjedočanstva“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… that he who perished (on that day) might perish by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty) and he who survived might survive by a clear proof” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Say - For Allah's is the final argument - Had He willed He could indeed have guided all of you.

explanation.bs: „Reci: Allahov je konačni argument“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Say - For Allah's is the final argument” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And those who argue concerning Allah after He hath been acknowledged, their argument hath no weight with their Lord, and wrath is upon them and theirs will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: „A oni koji se o Allahu prepiru nakon što Mu je odgovoreno – njihov je argument ništavan kod njihova Gospodara“ – ar-Rāġib: i oboreni se zove argumentom.
explanation.en: “And those who argue concerning Allah after He hath been acknowledged, their argument hath no weight with their Lord” — ar-Rāġib: even a refuted one is called an argument.

quranTranslation.text: That is Our argument. We gave it unto Abraham against his folk. We raise unto degrees of wisdom whom We will. Lo! thy Lord is Wise, Aware.

explanation.bs: „Eto, taj Naš argument dali smo Ibrahimu protiv njegovog naroda.“
explanation.en: “That is Our argument. We gave it unto Abraham against his folk.”

quranTranslation.text: Wherein are plain memorials (of Allah's guidance); the place where Abraham stood up to pray; and whosoever entereth it is safe. And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither. As for him who disbelieveth, (let him know that) lo! Allah is Independent of (all) creatures.

explanation.bs: „Ljudi su Allahu dužni hodočastiti Kuću – onaj ko može naći put do nje“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to be able (to have the means)

quranTranslation.text: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).

explanation.bs: „I nisu ga mogli preći, niti su ga mogli probiti“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za dva oblika glagola (isṭāʿa i istaṭāʿa).
explanation.en: “And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it)” — ar-Rāġib cites it for two forms of the verb (isṭāʿa and istaṭāʿa).

gloss.en: to be able (to have the means)

quranTranslation.text: He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me.

explanation.bs: „Ti, zaista, nećeš moći sa mnom strpljivo izdržati“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za ono što je čovjeku teško zbog nenaviknutosti.
explanation.en: “Lo! thou canst not bear with me” — ar-Rāġib cites it for what is hard for a person for lack of practice.

gloss.en: to be able (to have the means)

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury, like him who spendeth his wealth only to be seen of men and believeth not in Allah and the Last Day. His likeness is as the likeness of a rock whereon is dust of earth; a rainstorm smiteth it, leaving it smooth and bare. They have no control of aught of that which they have gained. Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „… nad onim što su stekli nemaju nikakve moći“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… They have no control of aught of that which they have gained” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Allah coineth a similitude: (on the one hand) a (mere) chattel slave, who hath control of nothing, and (on the other hand) one on whom we have bestowed a fair provision from Us, and he spendeth thereof secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.

explanation.bs: „Allah daje primjer: rob, u tuđem posjedu, koji ni nad čim nema moći …“
explanation.en: “Allah coineth a similitude: (on the one hand) a (mere) chattel slave, who hath control of nothing …”

quranTranslation.text: Save those who repent before ye overpower them. For know that Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Izuzev onih koji se pokaju dok još nad njima nemate moći.“
explanation.en: “Save those who repent before ye overpower them.”

quranTranslation.text: Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „Gospodaru naš, ne opterećuj nas onim za šta nam nema snage!“ – ar-Rāġib: ono što nam je teško podnijeti.
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear!” — ar-Rāġib: what is hard for us to undergo.

quranTranslation.text: And when Saul set out with the army, he said: Lo! Allah will try you by (the ordeal of) a river. Whosoever therefore drinketh thereof he is not of me, and whosoever tasteth it not he is of me, save him who taketh (thereof) in the hollow of his hand. But they drank thereof, all save a few of them. And after he had crossed (the river), he and those who believed with him, they said: We have no power this day against Goliath and his hosts. But those who knew that they would meet Allah exclaimed: How many a little company hath overcome a mighty host by Allah's leave! Allah is with the steadfast.

explanation.bs: „Nemamo mi danas snage za Džaluta i njegove vojnike“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet u istom značenju.
explanation.en: “We have no power [ṭāqa: strength] this day against Goliath and his hosts” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah in the same sense.

quranTranslation.text: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

explanation.bs: „Javi Mojim robovima da sam Ja, doista, Onaj Koji prašta, Milostivi“ – kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “… verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful” — as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive.

explanation.bs: „… da im isplati njihove nagrade i doda im od Svoje dobrote; On, uistinu, prašta i zahvalan je“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ‚ġafūrun šakūr‘ među Allahovim opisima.
explanation.en: “That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive” — ar-Rāġib cites ‘ġafūrun šakūr’ among Allah's descriptions.

quranTranslation.text: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „Pa sam rekao: ‚Tražite oprost od svoga Gospodara, On, uistinu, mnogo prašta‘“ – Nuhove riječi; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving [ġaffār]” — Noah's words; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: Onaj Koji mnogo i iznova prašta

quranTranslation.text: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.

explanation.bs: „A Ja, zaista, mnogo opraštam onome ko se pokaje, povjeruje i čini dobro, pa potom ostane na pravom putu“ – kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And lo! verily I am Forgiving [ġaffār] toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright” — as befits Him.

gloss.bs: Onaj Koji mnogo i iznova prašta

quranTranslation.text: As for such, it may be that Allah will pardon them. Allah is ever Clement, Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „Možda će im Allah pokloniti oprost – Allah je Onaj Koji grijehe briše i Koji prašta“ – ar-Rāġib navodi isti opis, u riječima 4:43.
explanation.en: “As for such, it may be that Allah will pardon them. Allah is ever Clement [ʿafuww], Forgiving” — ar-Rāġib cites the same description, in the wording of 4:43.

quranTranslation.text: If ye do good openly or keep it secret, or forgive evil, lo! Allah is ever Forgiving, Powerful.

explanation.bs: „Činili dobro javno ili ga krili, ili preko zla prešli – Allah je Onaj Koji grijehe briše i sve može“ – ljudima koji prelaze preko zla Allah je opisan istim korijenom; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “If ye do good openly or keep it secret, or forgive evil, lo! Allah is ever Forgiving [ʿafuww], Powerful” — to people who pass over evil Allah is described with the same root; as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „… a među njima ima i onih što idu na dvije noge …“ – noge kao ud za hodanje, u ajetu o stvorenjima koja hodaju na trbuhu, na dvije i na četiri.
explanation.en: “… and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs …” — legs as the limb for walking, in the ayah of creatures going on their bellies, on two and on four.

quranTranslation.text: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.

explanation.bs: „Na današnji dan stavljamo pečat na njihova usta; ruke im Nama progovaraju, a noge svjedoče o onom što su zarađivali“ – noge kao svjedok djela.
explanation.en: “This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet [arjul, legs] bear witness as to what they used to earn” — the legs as witnesses to deeds.

quranTranslation.text: And when they went into the field against Goliath and his hosts they said: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „… Gospodaru naš, izlij na nas strpljivost, učvrsti naša stopala …“ – vjernici pred Džalutovom vojskom traže čvrst oslonac, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure” — Pickthall's ‘foothold’ renders aqdām, the feet: the believers facing Goliath's hosts ask to stand firm, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Make not your oaths a deceit between you, lest a foot should slip after being firmly planted and ye should taste evil forasmuch as ye debarred (men) from the way of Allah, and yours should be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: „… pa da ne posrne stopalo nakon što je stajalo čvrsto …“ – kršenje zakletve poređeno je sa stopalom koje izgubi oslonac.
explanation.en: “… lest a foot should slip after being firmly planted” — breaking oaths is likened to a foot that loses its footing.
